about: What the notes drawer must show for the reader's own notes in one chapter's notes file (RD-18). Each case is a whole notes file and the notes it holds, as [section heading, text, anchor]. The highlights of the old comment are not in `shows`: the drawer reads them apart. The Rust tests (src-tauri/src/vault/notes_drawer_tests.rs) and the TypeScript tests (notesAggregator.test.ts) both read this file, so the two languages answer the same cases.
